“As for where they came from? A mystery.”

Title
Your shuttle, packed with security men, approaches the facility

Hidden inside a hollowed-out asteroid on the edge of {FacilityLocation}, it’s well concealed. You take your ship in.

You’re greeted by countless vats stretching off into darkness. Each holds a humanoid form, warped by monstrous science. A dozen are empty: were these awoken to launch that attack?

“Looks like a pre-Collapse black-ops project." {D(Assignee)} leaf{s(Assignee)} through a file. "Enhancements for the Elite Division of the Interstellar Authority... scrapped... resources shifted to ‘anabolic project’...”
We’ll wake them soon: we can unleash them on our enemies
